items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Lawrence Brown on trombone... One of the outstanding things was on that date was Lawrence Brown's trombone playing behind the side 'Morning Glory' -- behind Joe Turner when he sang

ctx.x: Lawrence Brown, Brownie. And they were on String and I forget what the other sides were.
"World on a String", with Woody Herman.
